plugins.name: agent-computer-use
plugins.description: Operate native macOS apps from an agent through two Accessibility-first MCP tools (state and act), with an optional voice runtime, Samantha (GPT-Live-1 or Grok Voice 3.0). macOS only.

plugins.name: comet-control
plugins.description: Drive and verify web apps in one leased, visible Perplexity Comet window per agent, through a local broker and an unpacked Comet extension. Never touches Google Chrome or its profiles. macOS only.

plugins.name: context-ledger
plugins.description: Local-first decision memory for agents: save the decisions and lessons from critical or recurring tasks, then look them up later through a scoped MCP server over a local SQLite ledger.
